tracePlayer.title: Recorded Dispatch Replay
tracePlayer.intro: Flux cannot compile to the web. This playground replays a real recorded test run — the source, the wire frame, and the view tree — and steps through the reconcile trace (dispatch → signals → dirty → update → step_end).
tracePlayer.webImpossible: Live web compilation is impossible by design. This replay is recorded, not live.
tracePlayer.tapHint: Each tap replays one dispatch step from the recorded trace.
